summary: SPK RC 43 don sach UI khong co backend va them nguon update ngay trong DSM Package Center (khong can upload .spk thu cong nua).
changes: Go bo cac nut trang tri chua co tinh nang: Phu de / Annotation focus / Sang mau (sap co), thanh volume gia, chip Appearance / Fields / Sorted by, folder Collections va Recently Deleted, muc Share Links.
Nut toan man hinh hoat dong that (fullscreen video), truoc day bam vao chi bat khung an toan.
Thanh buffered tren timeline hien dung du lieu buffer that cua video thay vi con so gia.
Go toan bo flow 'Cap nhat ngay' qua Watchtower (UI + API + config) — tan du cua ban Docker cu.
Them endpoint /spkserver: dung lam Package Source trong DSM Package Center. Them mot lan, tu do ve sau ban moi se hien nut Update ngay trong Package Center, du lieu giu nguyen.
Release CI dinh kem checksums.json (md5 + size) de DSM xac thuc file tai ve.
